title: When Does Adversarial Refinement Help? A Negative Result and Open Problem in Adapting R3GAN to Time Series Imputation
abstract: arXiv:2609.23102v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion models and transformers have supplanted GANs for multivariate time series imputation, largely on grounds of GAN training instability. R3GAN (NeurIPS 2024) removes that instability via regularized relativistic losses with provable convergence, raising a natural question: do stable, modern GANs revive adversarial imputation? We adapt R3GAN to 1D temporal data with a coarse-to-fine refinement framework and a frequency-domain discriminator, and audit 14 saved configurations across 3 datasets. Because these are heterogeneous single runs, the evidence is descriptive rather than a matched causal ablation. We report a negative result. All five saved mean/zero-start configurations improve by 48.4-70.2%. Among eight eligible non-legacy linear-start configurations, the mean change is -0.7% (range -3.0% to +1.1%); a separate -21.9% legacy logging anomaly is retained for provenance but excluded from that aggregate. translated_title: 对抗精炼何时有效？将R3GAN应用于时间序列插补的负面结果与开放问题
translated_abstract: 扩散模型和Transformer已在多变量时间序列插补任务中取代了GAN，其主要原因在于GAN训练的不稳定性。R3GAN（NeurIPS 2024）通过具有可证明收敛性的正则化相对论损失消除了这种不稳定性，由此引出一个自然的问题：稳定的现代GAN能否复兴对抗式插补方法？我们将R3GAN适配到一维时间数据上，采用了由粗到精的精炼框架和频域判别器，并对3个数据集上的14个已保存配置进行了审计。由于这些是异质的单次运行结果，相关证据是描述性的，而非匹配的因果消融实验。我们报告了一个负面结果：所有五个已保存的均值/零起点配置提升了48.4%至70.2%；而在八个符合条件的非遗留线性起点配置中，平均变化为-0.7%（范围从-3.0%到+1.1%）；一个单独的-21.9%遗留日志异常因来源追溯目的被保留，但已从该汇总统计中排除。在一个已保存的Weather比较……
tldr: 本文将具备可证明收敛性的现代稳定GAN（R3GAN）通过由粗到精精炼框架和频域判别器适配到时间序列插补任务，但实验报告了一个负面结果——对抗精炼在大多数配置下并未带来改进，从而留下一个开放问题。
en_tdlr: This paper adapts the provably convergent modern GAN (R3GAN) to time series imputation via a coarse-to-fine refinement framework and a frequency-domain discriminator, but reports a negative result that adversarial refinement does not help in most configurations, leaving an open problem.
